crossRefs.note: God’s sons saw that men’s daughters were beautiful, and they took any that they wanted for themselves as wives.
Rebekah said to Isaac, “I am weary of my life because of the daughters of Heth. If Jacob takes a wife of the daughters…
Isaac called Jacob, blessed him, and commanded him, “You shall not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan.
Arise, go to Paddan Aram, to the house of Bethuel your mother’s father. Take a wife from there from the daughters of…
Esau saw that the daughters of Canaan didn’t please Isaac, his father.

people.name: Isaac
people.line: Son of Abraham; father of Jacob and Esau.

people.name: Rebekah
people.line: Wife of Isaac; mother of Jacob and Esau

translations.web: They grieved Isaac’s and Rebekah’s spirits.
translations.bsb: And they brought grief to Isaac and Rebekah.
translations.kjv: Which were a grief of mind unto Isaac and to Rebekah.
translations.asv: And they were a grief of mind unto Isaac and to Rebekah.
